Forum Fortress API connection and spam protection settings.
Automatically ban repeat spammers for seven days

Off by default. Requires two distinct confirmed blocks with original scores strictly above 80 within 24 hours. Only ordinary members registered less than seven days ago with at most ten posts qualify. Staff, administrators, moderators, guests, system accounts and already banned members are excluded. A queued job rechecks eligibility and applies a reversible native seven-day ban. Registrations and unavailable or legacy API assessments never count. Repeat-spammer cleanup is separately disabled by default and requires its own three-event, five-post gate.

Clean repeat spammers with XenForo Spam Cleaner

Off by default. Requires three distinct repeat_cleanup_eligible BLOCKs within 24 hours and five or fewer posts. When enabled, cleanup takes precedence over the two-event ban-only option. A queued job rechecks the member and runs XenForo's native Spam Cleaner as a moderator with Spam Cleaner permission, soft-deleting authored replies and profile messages, including messages in restricted forums, and applying a seven-day native ban. The five-post limit is an account eligibility check, not a cap on profile messages. The job forces soft deletion for this call, regardless of the saved Spam Cleaner message action, so the native Spam Cleaner log can restore content and user status. It does not check IPs, remove thread starters, delete conversations, remove avatars or banners, or run native user spam submission.
